scientific_integrity: Universal claims follow the documented strict-convexity, arrowhead and cubic-root proof. Finite verification is supplemental, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact characterization only for unit-conductance stars with independent, nonnegative, unit-cost diagonal ground gains and fixed total budget; star-specific implicit scalar optimum outside the hub-free phase. Published equivalences may remain unindexed.
title: Reentrant hub grounding in A-optimal noisy star consensus
